# ISPH IGCSE ACHIEVEMENT 2025

Collectively, the cohort attained 28% A* grades, 48% A*/A grades, and a 100% pass rate, with notable success in Mathematics, Physics and English.
? Distinguished achievers include:
- Tue Anh: 7A*, 3A
- Ngoc Linh: 6A*, 3A
- Hai An: 7A*, 3A
- Minh Quan: 1A*, 6A
- Nguyen Binh: 4A*, 3A
These results reflect the intellectual commitment of the students, the academic guidance provided by ISPH teachers, and the consistent support of their families. Beyond the numerical outcomes, the 2025 IGCSE performance demonstrates the students’ readiness for the academic rigour of A Level, where they will continue to strengthen their knowledge and prepare for entry to leading universities worldwide.

13
Aug
# Congratulation Class of 2025 on World-Class A Level Success
After weeks of anticipation, the moment the entire ISPH community had been waiting for has finally arrived!
The results of the A-Level examinations, officially released by Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE), have brought overwhelming joy and pride to our whole community:
- 68% of grades at A* – A
- 93% of grades at A* – B
- 100% of grades at A* – C
While the 2025 results from the Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation (OFQUAL), the UK’s trusted authority for international examination statistics, have not yet been published, a comparison with the 2024 figures highlights the remarkable achievement of our students.
In 2024, 27% of students in the UK achieved grades A*- A, and 53% achieved grades A-B.
This year’s ISPH results are significantly higher across all grade bands.
...
Congratulations to all Year 13 students and their families for excelling in such a demanding examination.
We look forward to more remarkable results from our pioneering A-Level cohort, and stay tuned for the upcoming release of ISPH’s 2025 IGCSE results, which we are confident will bring even more cause for celebration!
results.title: Congratulation Class of 2025 on World-Class A Level Success

# Category: News & Updates
## IGCSE Results 2025-2026
We’re delighted to celebrate our recent cohort of students following the release of this year’s IGCSE results.
These results, achieved across such a broad range of subjects, reflect not only our students’ academic achievements, but also the commitment, resilience and determination they have demonstrated throughout their studies.

## AS-Level Results 2025-2026
Following on from our fantastic A-Level results, we are equally delighted to celebrate the achievements of our Year 12 students, who recently received their AS Level results.
Congratulations to all of our students on their hard work and achievements.
These results provide a strong foundation as they now move into their final year at ISP, and we look forward to seeing all that they will accomplish in the year ahead.
## A-Level Results 2025-2026
With our A-Level results now in, we are incredibly proud to celebrate the achievements of our Class of 2026.
Their hard work, determination and resilience have resulted in some fantastic outcomes across a wide range of subjects.
On average, our students achieved grades 0.53 higher than those predicted based on their CAT4 assessments.
This value-added measure demonstrates the significant progress our students make and reflects the impact of the high-quality teaching, personalised support and encouragement they receive throughout their learning journey at ISP.

# ISPH Students Receive Outstanding Results!
As promised in our recent update on A-Level achievements, ISPH’s “Breaking News” returns with yet another highlight.
This time with our students receiving exceptional IGCSE results!
Results at a glance:
A*–A: 48% A*–B: 70% A*–C: 92% 100% pass rate
This marks the third consecutive year ISPH students have taken the IGCSE examinations, and once again, the outcomes are exceptional.
What is even more remarkable is that year-on-year progress is clearly visible:
A*-A increased by 8% compared to 2023 and 4% compared to 2024, A*-B rose by 14% and 6% respectively, A*-C achieved a remarkable leap, up 16% from 2023 and 15% from 2024.
These back-to-back successes in both A-Level and IGCSE results not only enrich our students’ record of achievements but also set the tone for an inspiring and promising new academic year.

results.snippet:
# A-Level At ISPH – Gateway To Global Scholarships
***A solid academic foundation from the A-Level programme not only helps students prove themselves through exams and scholarship selection rounds, but also enables them to excel from their very first days at university.***
The story of Tho Quang – ISPH alumnus who graduated in 2025 – is the clearest testament to this.
Completing the 2024-2025 academic year with outstanding A-Level results (3A* and 1A in Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, and Physics), Quang is honored to be one of the few Vietnamese students to receive a 100% full scholarship from the Hong Kong Government to study Computer Science at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) – one of Asia’s leading universities, ranked #3 in Hong Kong, #44 globally, and among the top 10 universities in Asia according to QS World University Ranking 2025.
...
### THE PATH TO SUCCESS
For Quang, the HKUST scholarship was not a matter of luck, but the result of a personalized learning pathway with clear direction from his very first days at ISPH.
- **Discovering passion through IGCSE** Quang had the freedom to choose 11 diverse subjects – from STEM (Computer Science, Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology) to arts and humanities (English, English Literature, Global Perspectives, Drama) – to explore his interests and strengths.
- **Focusing on strengths at A-Level** After identifying his passion for Computer Science, Quang concentrated on 4 suitable subjects and achieved outstanding results of 3A* and 1A in Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, and Physics.
results.title: A-Level At ISPH – Gateway To Global Scholarships

# Results
We release exam results in January (following the November exam series) and August (June exam series).
Your school will tell you when your results will be available and how you will receive them.
You might need to go to your school to collect your results, or your school might give you a password so that you can view your results on our secure website.

content.text:
ISPH Hanoi’s published **2025 results** were:

| Exam | Key results |
|---|---|
| **IGCSE** | 100% pass rate; 48% of grades A*–A; 70% A*–B; 92% A*–C |
| **A Level** | 68% of grades A*–A; 93% A*–B; 100% A*–C |

The school also reported that its first A Level cohort included students earning multiple A* grades. These figures are from ISPH’s published results announcements: [IGCSE](https://isph.edu.vn/isph-students-receive-outstanding-results/) · [A Level](https://isph.edu.vn/congratulation-class-of-2025-on-world-class-a-level-success/).
